site.name: Sparrow Proxy Panel
site.description: Self-hosted proxy service panel: plans, orders, subscriptions and nodes in one place.

auth.subtitle: Sign in to manage your subscriptions and nodes
auth.failed: Sign-in failed, please check your email and password

hero.title: Self-hosted proxy service panel
hero.description: Plans, orders, subscriptions and nodes in one place. The panel and the node agent are decoupled, so nodes deploy and upgrade independently.

features.title: Core capabilities
features.description: Everything needed to run a proxy service

panel.title: Operations panel
panel.description: Plans, orders, payments, subscriptions, users and logs — all in one back office.

agent.title: Node agent
agent.description: A single-binary CLI that fetches config, reports traffic, self-updates and keeps serving when the panel is down.

plugin.title: Plugin ecosystem
plugin.description: Payment gateways, third-party node sources and subscription renderers are pluggable — no core changes needed.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: UI, subscriptions and notifications are localized; Simplified Chinese and English out of the box.
